body.statement: For the exact-support witness graphs \(G_\star,H_\star\), \(\mathcal P_{\{\varnothing\}}(G_\star)=\mathcal P_{\{\varnothing\}}(H_\star)\) for every admissible \(a,b,c,d\) with \(abcd(1-ab)\ne0\), but any intervention family containing \(\{X_1\}\) separates them. Under \(\operatorname{do}(X_1=z)\), every \(G_\star\) kernel satisfies \(\operatorname{Cov}(X_2,X_3)=0\), whereas every \(H_\star\) kernel satisfies \(\operatorname{Cov}(X_2,X_3)=-(c/a)d\sigma_L^2\ne0\). The row exchange and source rescaling give a bijection of the entire exact-support observational parameter spaces.
body.justification: A uniform all-parameter witness proves that the interventional quotient is strictly finer than the observational quotient without relying on genericity.
body.gap: The zero-allowed version of this witness is false at zero pivots; the claim here is restricted to the newly specified exact nonzero support and re-proves the full parameter-space bijection directly.
body.consumer: The witness tells perturbation planners when one observed-node intervention resolves a feedback reversal and latent-parent ambiguity that no observational sample can resolve.
